overview.description: The OneAscent Enhanced Small and Mid Cap ETF Institutional Shs OneAscent Emerging Markets Fund (OAEM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively invests in an equity portfolio of large-, mid-, and small-cap emerging market companies. The fund combines an ESG screening methodology with its fundamental investment process. OAEM was launched on Sep 15, 2022 and is issued by Oneascent.
